name: Himax HM0360 low-power VGA mono camera
description: An ultra-low-power BSI monochrome VGA sensor for always-on TinyML vision (person detection, wake-on-motion). Draws about 8 mA at VGA 60 fps and a few hundred µA in monitor mode. Runs on an RP2040, Arduino or Cortex-M.

variants.note: Arducam board for RP2040/Arduino, 2×13 0.1" header (the Pico examples use 8 signals in 1-bit serial mode)

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: Despite the 'SPI camera' name, the Arducam board streams 1-, 4- or 8-bit parallel/serial data, not SPI.
Himax's own FPC module HM0360-MWA-00FW703 (30-pin, 85° diagonal lens) is on LCSC as C17291166.
The array is 656×496, windowed to 640×480. Has binning and ROI readout and context switching for low-power duty cycling.
